title: Abbreviations
html:
Like any game Dungeon Runners generates its own set of abbreviations. You will frequently see these in chat, and sometimes in these pages. Many of them are also common to most chat rooms.

IN ALPHABETICAL ORDER


Abbr. Definition
Abby Abaddon
afk away from keyboard. Taking a break for a short time.
brb be right back
bio break break for... well, biological necessities.
blues or blue pots Mana potions
def Defense rating
dev game developer (or Godlike Being)
DW Mommy .........  ;o) .......... No, really, it means Dear Wife
HDoL Horrific Dungeon of Legend
insane the top difficulty, for example "LFG for SC insane"
juice potions
KC King Coins
LFG Looking for Group or Looking for Farming Group
LOL Laugh Out Loud
luda Ludicrous speed, or a weapon so rated
LvL Level, used as a verb (LFG to lvl) and an adjective (lvl 22 armor)
mob mobile object, i.e. usually a Monster
Noob A new Person and/or a derogatory term indicating that a person has no clue what they are talking about
pots potions
PWN To "own" someone or a mob; to defeat them easily
Pwned When you lose and don't have a chance, or when you have somebody else pwned and they don't have a chance.
Ratty Ratsputin
rb Rainbow item
rb sally Gypsy Sally selling rainbow items
reds or red pots Health potions
ROC Room of Creation
sally Gypsy Sally
sam Sam's Dungeon Wholesale
SC Snow Chieftain's Lair or the Snow Chieftain, Algor the Cold
sissi Sissirat or Sissirat's Lair
spam pots Use lots of potions quickly in a tough fight
TY Thank You
tyvm Thank You Very Much
wep weapon
wp Compass Waypoint, for example "Anyone for SC insane? I have wp"
wtt Want to Trade, players use this in market chat messages
xp Experience points
